excerpt:
> This comment was posted by Codex Desktop using gpt-6.1-sol on behalf of David.

## What's Changed
### 🛡️ Security
* **High — HTML conversion in `web_fetch`:** [GHSA-4whf-38hw-pxxh](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/security/advisories/GHSA-4whf-38hw-pxxh). When `web_fetch_tool` fetched attacker-controlled HTML containing many elements, conversion could delay unrelated work in the same process. Fixed in v2.59.0 and v1.107.9. Upgrade if the tool can fetch such pages.

### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Remove shut-down Groq models `playai-tts`, `playai-tts-arabic`, `meta-llama/llama-guard-4-12b` and `meta-llama/llama-4-maverick-17b-128e-instruct` by @mekanbaymyradov in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10306
* Distinguish omitted provider usage from reported zero and add `UsageLimitUnavailableWarning` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9491
* Add `on_change='append'` to preserve dynamic instruction prefixes by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8188
* Stop recording that a realtime session ended when a tool raised, and document that it goes on by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10782
* Record
